title: 恐龙住了一亿六千万年 · 素材
subtitle: 给对比页用的单体素材
style: children's picture book illustration, soft chalk pastel with grainy blended strokes and a visible grain in the surface, dusty violet, slate blue and warm rose

pages.scene: One single small early dinosaur about the size of a big dog, standing on two legs, seen from the side facing left, with a long tail held straight out behind it, its whole body inside the picture. The background is one flat cream colour of a single even tone that fills the whole picture right out to all four edges. The object floats on this flat colour: it casts no shadow and rests on no ground, and there is no darker patch, wash, puddle, base, line or platform of any kind underneath it. There is no sky, no horizon, no clouds and no scenery of any kind behind it: the cream colour is the only thing behind the object, exactly as if the object had been cut out and laid on blank paper.
